1Summary

Automated checks found nothing that blocks interpretation. Results are ready for scientific review.

15,722 of 0 genes passed the expression filter and were tested across 15 samples for the contrast group: HFD vs NCD. At an adjusted p-value threshold of 0.05, 23 genes were differentially expressed (20 up, 3 down).

The strongest increases were Plin5, Sik1, Acot2, Nr4a2, Zfp36, Fosl2, and the strongest decreases Plet1os, Actc1, Zfp503.

Pathway analysis of the ranked gene list recovered HALLMARK TNFA Signaling via NFKB (NES +2.85), GOBP Protein Refolding (NES +2.62), GOBP Fatty Acid Beta Oxidation (NES +2.41), GOBP Melanocyte Differentiation (NES +2.33) (FDR < 0.25).

4Differential expression

15,722 of 0 genes passed the expression filter and were tested across 15 samples for the contrast group: HFD vs NCD. At an adjusted p-value threshold of 0.05, 23 genes were differentially expressed (20 up, 3 down).

The strongest increases were Plin5, Sik1, Acot2, Nr4a2, Zfp36, Fosl2, and the strongest decreases Plet1os, Actc1, Zfp503.

Pathway analysis of the ranked gene list recovered HALLMARK TNFA Signaling via NFKB (NES +2.85), GOBP Protein Refolding (NES +2.62), GOBP Fatty Acid Beta Oxidation (NES +2.41), GOBP Melanocyte Differentiation (NES +2.33) (FDR < 0.25).

The volcano tests every gene on its own, so it cannot say whether the hits are one coordinated response or several that happen to share a cut-off. This asks the samples: genes whose sample-to-sample profiles rise and fall together are placed near each other, and the shaded regions are what average-linkage clustering makes of those distances.

Here the two groups are the two directions: the 20 induced genes move as one block and the 3 repressed genes as another, with nothing of substance crossing between them. That is a result rather than a tautology — genes that share a direction need not share a profile, and when they do it means one programme went up and one went down together across these subjects, not that many genes drifted independently.

Support comes from re-running the whole grouping on 200 bootstrap resamples of the samples and counting how often each group survived intact (20 genes at 0.99, 3 genes at 0.99). This matters more than it usually would: with 15 samples a gene-gene correlation carries a standard error near 0.3, which is enough to assemble a convincing module out of nothing. Treat anything under about 0.7 as a picture, and read the support before the shape.

Every group here clears that bar, so the arrangement is stable under resampling — the genes listed together would still be listed together in a different cohort of this size.

5Pathway enrichment

4636 gene sets were tested against the ranked gene list; 229 reached FDR < 0.25.

Each bar is its own test, and its length is the result rather than a count of anything. The normalised enrichment score asks how far towards one end of the ranked gene list a set's members sit, and divides by what sets of that size reach on permuted data — so a 20-gene set and a 200-gene one can be put side by side. The sign is the direction: positive means higher in the treatment group.

Bars at full strength passed FDR 0.25 and carry their value; faded bars were tested and did not. The figure shows the strongest 14 of the 5217 sets that had enough measured genes to test.

9Literature context

Every hit was counted against Europe PMC: how often it appears alongside this experiment's context, against how often it would by chance given how much the gene is studied at all. That denominator is what separates a specific finding from a famous gene — without it a loading control outranks a real one.

8 of the tested hits are already established here; 0 are studied elsewhere but have no literature in this context, which is where a follow-up would start.

10Methods

Expression was modelled linearly on the log2 scale with the design Intercept + group[HFD] + group[HFD_Ime]. Values arrived already summarised, so the negative-binomial model does not apply: it reads sequencing depth from the column totals, which a normalised matrix no longer carries, and rounding such a matrix into counts would put a variance structure on it that the data does not have.

Each gene's residual variance was shrunk towards a trend fitted through residual variance against average expression, with the prior strength estimated from the spread of the variances themselves (2.7 prior degrees of freedom against 12 residual). Tests are moderated t-tests on 14.7 degrees of freedom, corrected by Benjamini-Hochberg after independent filtering on average expression. Smyth, Stat. Appl. Genet. Mol. Biol. 3 (2004).

Genes were ranked by the Wald statistic of the contrast. Pre-ranked gene set enrichment analysis was run with a weighted Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic (weight = 1.0) and 1000 gene-label permutations per set; enrichment scores were normalised by the mean absolute score of same-sign permutations and the resulting p-values adjusted by Benjamini-Hochberg. Leading-edge genes are those contributing to the running statistic up to its extremum.

Gene sets: MSigDB v2025.1 Hallmark + GO:BP. Gene sets: MSigDB v2025.1 (Hallmark and GO Biological Process), Broad Institute and UC San Diego, used under CC BY 4.0. Liberzon et al., Cell Systems 2015; Subramanian et al., PNAS 2005. Sets were restricted to those with between 8 and 500 measured genes; figures and the narrative show the strongest sets after removing those whose leading edge repeats one already shown (Jaccard > 0.6), while the tables carry every set tested.
